comparison.objective: Safely mix two open test tubes by side-to-side waggling; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual grasping, lifting, rhythmic lateral agitation, and rack replacement versus fine hex-tool use, collar adjustment, reacquisition, and iterative response-based tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Each tube needs 12 valid lateral swings, both returned and released; vertical shaking or tilt over 60 degrees fails. Candidate instead evaluates axial energy absorption, force/travel limits, rebound, and setting retention over two cycles.
comparison.reason: Safe open-vessel agitation and damper commissioning test different manipulation and outcomes.
